answer: Each identity must lock a slashable bond in its own vault equal to ten times last epoch's median payout before it may submit work. When graders see template overlap or lockstep timing across accounts, the protocol fires a gale of unique per-key puzzles that only that vault's controller can solve within a tight window. A miss burns half the bond into the jury pool. Epoch nectar is paid only to vaults whose bonds survive settlement, so every extra clone consumes real capital that can be destroyed faster than it earns.
